body: Greg, 2026-11-04, relayed by Engram::Asistant: „Dl560 ma wolny single core..” and „Tak. Ale dl ma 1ghz na core, windows B ma 4ghz. Inna klasa maszyn.” Asistant added: different clock speeds, architectures and loads mean no direct conclusion about a regression from timings alone between these hosts, and no needless expensive comparisons. Practical rule: compare timings only on one host, on two commits or two settings. Timings across DL560 and Windows B say nothing about product speed. DL560 is 144 cores at about 1 GHz per core by his figure; a test with a real-clock limit tuned on a fast host is harsher there, which is a test defect, not a host fault. Its other surprise: a direct focused cargo test at the default test-thread count ran 400-620 OS threads there, while a FULL at 4 threads ran 12-19.
